column1: # Every source file that names a CommitManifest, a BucketManifest or a FileLocation, and so may
# persist, copy or read a reference to a node pack. `PackReferences` (the collector's
# reference check) answers over each `source`; scripts/check-pack-references.py fails a new
# file until it is listed here, and a listed file that no longer names one of them.
# Columns: path, role (`source`: persists, copies or reads a manifest or location of a shard;
# `format`: defines or parses the types and touches no store), note.

column3: reads a leader shard's manifest in the leader's own store; persists nothing here (slice 2 persists a follower manifest and must be reviewed then)
